body: I lie there, frozen, my heart pounding in my chest. The fire light casts eerie shadows on the walls, making me feel like I'm being watched. I try to push the thoughts of the choir loft light out of my mind, but they linger, refusing to be dismissed. I think about the choir director, Mr. Thompson, who warned us about the dangers of candles, but I didn't listen.
